goal: Lua review: sandboxing, global variables, input handling and error propagation.
use: Lua review: sandboxing, global variables, input handling and error propagation. Use when asked to review a Lua script or embedded configuration.

steps.note: Read the script and where it runs. Embedded, game, or server.
Check the sandbox. Flag scripts with access to the file system or os library.
Check globals. Flag accidental global variables.
Check input. Flag input passed to load or loadstring.
Report. Each finding with line, severity and the fix.
